items.note: The corrected intake now makes the F23 project artifact and topic lab required, sequences the project before F24 review, and specifies observable outcomes for all five frozen F23 rows, a reusable canonical brief, prerequisite alignment, a starter scaffold, and public Maven/JUnit tests. The new topic manifest and module order implement the plan without splitting the frozen project row.

The corrected lab plan removes H2 and requires learner-local PostgreSQL through pinned pgJDBC, with an isolated database created and dropped by the single Maven test command and no learner-side container engine. The F23 project outcomes and public tests now exercise the named PostgreSQL integration.

The corrected blueprint retains the frozen MCQ and coding formats, 45-minute duration, and 70 percent pass mark while mapping the coding format to jdbc-review#o1 and jdbc-data-access-project#o2; its learner instructions now explicitly include querying a database from Java with JDBC rather than SQL-only coding.

The corrected objective removes LIMIT/OFFSET and instead asks learners to predict ordering and make it deterministic with explicit sort keys and a tie-breaker. The blueprint now samples the frozen topic's filtering objective o1 rather than the removed pagination objective.
